title: 40-year class reunion brings back fond memories | The Star
text:
40-year class reunion brings back fond memories | The Star
It's catch-up time for a group of old boys and girls from Selangor's SMK Hulu Kelang.
When 33 ex-classmates of SMK Hulu Kelang in Ampang, Selangor met up for a reunion dinner after 40 years, it was a night of nostalgia as old memories came flooding back.
